annotations.text: How a domain model transforms through ongoing dialog. The standing proposal 'every patient is insured' is audited against M after each revision; the verdict moves FALSE→TRUE→FALSE→TRUE as the dialogue admits evidence and a new individual unsettles a settled universal. M carries its own diachronic history — the dialogue that made it what it is, replayable in Organon. No model is ever frozen (docs/MANIFEST_AND_MEANING.md).

Each step is a model-revising 'new_fact' disposition (src/model_revision.py): an independent proposal the dialogue accepts as evidence, juxtaposed onto M's sheet as a new posit at low warrant. Enlargement here; retraction (free to demote, the ERA dual) is the other licensed move.
M0 (the opening record): 'every patient is insured' peels to FALSE.
M1: 'every patient is insured' peels to TRUE.
M2: 'every patient is insured' peels to FALSE.
M3: 'every patient is insured' peels to TRUE.
